title: Grundy domination checks: exact solver, Julia programs and Lean 4 certificates
description: Code for the Grundy domination number of graphs and graph products. It contains an exact C solver for the Grundy domination number with Python search drivers, two Julia programs that recompute ranks of closed-neighbourhood pattern matrices over finite fields and check dominating sequences (strong and direct products of cycles, the graphs H_N, Kneser graphs K(n,r), incidence graphs of projective planes), and Lean 4 files (core library only) that certify the finite dominating sequences and rank factorizations by kernel evaluation. No paper is included.
